text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Satono-san. I pray for 
your continued success in the future. 
And...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I have prepared a celebratory gift of my 
own as well. I will bring it to your room 
later.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—!! McQueen-san, for my sake... He did 
that for me...!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh~!! I'll... I'll treasure it forever 
and ever, okay? ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, the thought alone is more than 
enough. After all, what I've prepared this 
time is—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Which means this is a 
once-in-a-lifetime chance to challenge 
that jinx...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"If you slip a gift from someone you 
admire under your pillow before sleeping, 
you'll end up having a nightmare for some 
reason"?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
U-Under your pillow...?! Um, Satono-san? I 
really think you should reconsider that—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu♪ No matter what, even if it's in a 
dream, I have to break this jinx with 
everything I've got! All right, time to 
give it my all~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
S-She's completely in her own world... 
but, I still have to let her know...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My gift to you is— a "Mejiro Family 
Special Birthday Cake"...?!
